Planning your first hike or a Mt Kenya climb raises lots of questions: what to buy first, whether thrifted gear is worth it, and how to avoid kit that fails on the trail. This buyer's guide answers where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi and how to choose each item well.

For a wide choice of trail-ready kit, the top answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi is to visit our Thika Road shop at Mountain Mall, 3rd Floor, Shop D39. Mountain Mall is close to Kasarani, Garden Estate and Thome, which makes it an easy stop on your way in or out of the city.

If you cannot get to Thika Road, online ordering is another answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi. Browse the full range at hikingoutdoorhub.com and pay with M-Pesa or cash on delivery, which suits hikers anywhere in Nairobi who know their sizes.

What makes a good place to buy hiking gear?

A good place to buy hiking gear lets you try items on, compare several brands and sizes side by side, and ask questions about fit and use. Those three things matter more than a long catalogue when you are deciding where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi.

When weighing where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi, remember that trying gear on matters most for boots, backpacks and jackets, because fit decides comfort on a long day. Smaller items such as socks, gloves and headlamps are easy to order online once you know what you want.

What Hiking Gear Should You Buy First?

Buy hiking boots, a waterproof jacket, a comfortable daypack and a warm mid-layer first. These four items cover most day hikes near Nairobi, from Ngong Hills to Mt Longonot, and you can add specialist kit later as your hikes get longer and higher.

PriorityItemWhy it matters in Kenya
1Hiking boots or trail shoesGrip on loose volcanic scree and muddy forest paths
2Waterproof rain jacketLong rains (March–May) and short rains (October–December) bring sudden downpours
3Daypack (20–30 L)Carries water, food, layers and a first-aid kit comfortably
4Fleece or warm mid-layerRidges and high forests turn cold in wind, cloud and rain
5Hiking socksCushioning and moisture control prevent blisters
6Water bottles or hydration packCarry at least 2–3 litres on exposed, hot trails
7Hat, sunglasses and sunscreenEquatorial sun is strong, especially at altitude

What gear do you need for a day hike near Nairobi?

A day hike near Nairobi needs sturdy footwear, 2–3 litres of water, snacks, a rain jacket, a warm layer, sun protection and a charged phone. A 28L day hiking backpack fits all of this with room to spare, and a 3L hydration backpack lets you drink without stopping.

For a fuller list, the Ten Essentials checklist from REI is a widely used safety standard, and our guide to hiking for beginners in Kenya adapts it to local trails.

What extra gear do you need for Mt Kenya or Kilimanjaro?

Mt Kenya and Kilimanjaro need warm, layered kit for nights below freezing: thermal base layers, a fleece, an insulated jacket, a waterproof shell, gloves, a warm hat, a headlamp and a sleeping bag suited to cold camps. Use our lists of what to pack for hiking Mt Kenya and the Kilimanjaro gear checklist when planning where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi for a big climb.

Should You Buy New or Thrifted Hiking Gear in Nairobi?

Thrifted hiking gear is often the smartest answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi on a budget, because quality outdoor brands are built to last, so a pre-owned item can perform like new for a fraction of the cost. Buy new when hygiene or safety-critical condition matters most.

Usually great thriftedOften better new
Rain jackets and softshellsUnderwear and base layers worn next to skin (personal preference)
Fleeces and insulated jacketsGas canisters and fuel
Backpacks and daypacksWater bladders, if you prefer a fresh one
Hiking boots with plenty of tread leftClimbing ropes and harnesses
Trekking poles, gaiters and glovesFirst-aid supplies

How do you tell if thrifted hiking gear is good quality?

Good-quality thrifted hiking gear comes from established outdoor brands, has intact seams and zips, and shows wear only in cosmetic places. Whichever answer you reach on where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi, check each item yourself before paying, focusing on the parts that fail first.

  1. Boots: deep tread, a firm midsole with no crumbling, and soles fully bonded to the upper.
  2. Jackets: seam tape lying flat inside, no flaking inner coating, and every zip running smoothly.
  3. Backpacks: strong shoulder-strap stitching, working buckles and a hip belt that still holds its shape.
  4. Sleeping bags: even loft with no bare cold spots, and a zip that runs the full length.
  5. Everything: try it on with the layers you will hike in.

Our guide to hiking boots for Kenyan trails goes deeper on boot materials and soles, and our rainy season hiking gear guide covers what to pack before the short rains, so you know exactly what to look for when deciding where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi.

Buyer's Checklist

  • Know your trip: Match gear to the hike, from Karura Forest strolls to Point Lenana at 4,985 m.
  • Bring your socks: Try boots on with the socks you hike in, ideally in the afternoon.
  • Load the pack: Test a backpack with some weight inside and the hip belt fastened.
  • Layer up: Try jackets over a fleece to be sure they still close and move freely.
  • Check the details: Zips, seams, buckles, soles and drawcords on every item.
  • Try before you buy: Choose where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi based on whether you can try items on.
  • Buy in order: Boots and a rain jacket first, then add layers and accessories.

How Can You Buy Hiking Gear on a Budget in Nairobi?

You can buy hiking gear on a budget in Nairobi by choosing quality thrifted items, buying the essentials first, and adding specialist kit only when your hikes need it. Spending well on boots and a rain jacket pays off more than buying everything at once.

Many items work across several activities. A good fleece serves on hikes, camping trips and cold Nairobi mornings, and merino wool hiking socks stay comfortable over several days. Our guide to layering for cold weather hikes shows how a few pieces combine for very different conditions.

Another way to save is to try a guided hike before buying everything. You will see what you actually use on the trail, which makes the next decision about where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi much easier.

How Do You Make Your Hiking Gear Last?

Make hiking gear last by cleaning it after each hike, drying it fully before storage, and re-proofing waterproof items when water stops beading. Most outdoor kit fails through neglect, such as mud left on boots or a damp pack stored in a cupboard.

Brush mud off boots and dry them slowly away from direct heat. Wash rain jackets with a technical cleaner rather than ordinary detergent. Recharge items such as a waterproof rechargeable headlamp after every trip so they are ready next time.

Frequently Asked Questions

Where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi?

The top answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi is Hiking Outdoor Gear Hub, Mountain Mall, 3rd Floor, Shop D39, Thika Road, near Kasarani, Garden Estate and Thome. Is thrifted hiking gear worth buying in Kenya?

Thrifted hiking gear is worth buying in Kenya when it comes from established outdoor brands and is in good condition. Jackets, fleeces, backpacks and boots with plenty of tread left can perform almost like new for much less money, which makes proper kit affordable for beginners and regular hikers alike.

Can I order hiking gear online in Nairobi?

Yes, online ordering is a convenient answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi: order at hikingoutdoorhub.com and pay with M-Pesa or cash on delivery. Online ordering works well for socks, gloves, hats and headlamps. For boots and backpacks, send your measurements on WhatsApp or visit the Mountain Mall shop on Thika Road to try them on.

Do I need park permits as well as gear?

Many hiking areas in Kenya, including Mt Longonot, Hell's Gate and Mt Kenya, are national parks or forest reserves that charge entry fees. Fees change, so confirm current rates and booking rules with Kenya Wildlife Service or Kenya Forest Service before your hike.

Final Thoughts

The simplest answer to where to buy hiking gear in Nairobi is a shop where you can try kit on and compare quality thrifted and new options. Start with boots, a rain jacket, a daypack and a warm layer, check every item carefully, and add specialist gear as your hikes grow.
